research_question: Can the existing native four-action lifecycle execute and audit one generated routing plus retirement-held queue contract without task-specific solver changes?
selection_rule: First of the two previously generated and industrially controlled composed contracts, shifted; selected by fixed production order before model calls.
eda_limit: one process group at a time; up to four fresh candidate grades; no model launch with active EDA or less than 4GiB free
stop_rules: Do not launch before runtime and concrete controls qualify.
Stop on trusted execution/information boundary failure.
No replacement sample for model failure, unsubmitted episode, or infrastructure interruption.
No additional stage API trial after this one.
offline_analysis: Replay logs and source transitions only; no new intermediate candidate grades, no heldout-based candidate or data selection.
scope: One exploratory task/rollout; no stable success rate, no cross-family causal comparison, no parameter training.
